Macro.Name: AddFace

Face.VertexIndexes: i1 + N; i2 + N; i2; i1

Macro.Name: AddTop
Macro.Script: i1 := c * N8; i0 := (i1 + N8) mod N;

Face.VertexIndexes: i0; N * 2; FromTo( i1, i1 + N8 - 1)

Macro.Name: AddBottom
Macro.Script: i0 := c * N8; i1 := (i0 + N8) mod N;

Face.VertexIndexes: i0 + N; N * 2 + 1; i1 + N; FromTo( i0 + N8 - 1 + N, i0 + 1 + N)
